## Description {#details}

<p>A binary fraction with an explicit integer bit.</p>


<p>The significand must be at least one bit wider than the target precision.</p>


<p>Definition at line 778 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/adt/apfloat-h">APFloat.h</a>.</p>
